methods.label: Reduce before adding
methods.explanation:
Both \(49\) and \(84\) are divisible by \(7\). Dividing the numerator and denominator by the same nonzero number preserves the fraction's value, so
\[\frac{49}{84}=\frac{49\div7}{84\div7}=\frac7{12}.\]
The only positive factors of \(7\) are \(1\) and \(7\), and \(7\) does not divide \(12\). Thus \(\frac7{12}\) is in simplest form. The requested sum is \(7+12=19\), choice \(\mathrm C\).
